method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: Original nationalization is contextually read as naturalization; disclosed in note, source unchanged.
Original secondary education retained literally; note distinguishes higher education at land-grant colleges.
Original Breckenridge spelling differs from historical Breckinridge; Chinese proper name remains consistent.

revisions.source: How should your party address the slavery issue during this campaign?
revisions.zh: 在这次竞选中，你们党应当如何处理奴隶制问题？

revisions.source: What do you have to say about the merits of your running mate, Hannibal Hamlin?
revisions.zh: 对于竞选搭档汉尼拔·哈姆林的优点，你有什么要说的？

revisions.source: To what extent do you plan to personally campaign in this election?
revisions.zh: 你打算在多大程度上亲自参加这次竞选活动？

revisions.source: How aggressively should your party attack the Southern Democrats and John Breckenridge in this election?
revisions.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当以多大力度攻击南方民主党人和约翰·布雷肯里奇？

revisions.source: How aggressively should your party attack the Northern Democrats and Stephen A. Douglas in this election?
revisions.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当以多大力度攻击北方民主党人和斯蒂芬·A.·道格拉斯？

revisions.source: How aggressively should your party attack the Constitutional Unionists and John Bell in this election?
revisions.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当以多大力度攻击宪法联邦党人和约翰·贝尔？

revisions.source: How much should your party emphasize its support of a Transcontinental Railroad in this election?
revisions.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当多大程度上强调对横贯大陆铁路的支持？

revisions.source: Would you support a compromise Amendment which permanently protected slavery in the Southern states, in return for no further expansion of the institution?
revisions.zh: 你是否支持一项妥协性的宪法修正案：永久保护南方各州的奴隶制，换取这一制度不再扩张？

revisions.source: How much should your party emphasize its support of higher tariffs in this election?
revisions.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当多大程度上强调对提高关税的支持？

revisions.source: If any Southern state was to secede, would you use military force as President to preserve the Union?
revisions.zh: 如果某个南方州脱离联邦，作为总统，你会动用武力维护联邦吗？

revisions.source: What is your position on the Supreme Court's Dred Scott v. Sandford decision?
revisions.zh: 你如何看待最高法院对德雷德·斯科特诉桑福德案的判决？

revisions.source: How much should your party emphasize its support of a homestead act in this election?
revisions.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当多大程度上强调对宅地法的支持？

revisions.source: Do you have anything to say about the efforts of some to reopen the Atlantic slave trade?
revisions.zh: 对于有人试图重启跨大西洋奴隶贸易，你有什么要说的？

revisions.source: What is your position on the social equality of blacks in American society?
revisions.zh: 你对美国社会中黑人的社会平等地位持什么立场？

revisions.source: What is your position on the passage of “personal liberty laws” by various states, to flout the Fugitive Slave Act?
revisions.zh: 一些州通过“个人自由法”，对抗《逃奴法》。你对此持什么立场？

revisions.source: What position should your party take on foreign immigration and nationalization in this election?
revisions.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当对外国移民与入籍问题采取什么立场？

revisions.source: Do you support the further expansion of the United States into Mexico, Cuba, or the Caribbean?
revisions.zh: 你是否支持美国进一步向墨西哥、古巴或加勒比地区扩张？

revisions.source: What should your party's position be on the raid of John Brown, late in 1859?
revisions.zh: 对于约翰·布朗在1859年末发动的突袭，你们党应当采取什么立场？

revisions.source: Do you have any plans to reach out to your chief rival for the Republican nomination, William Seward, and reconcile?
revisions.zh: 你是否打算向共和党提名战中的主要对手威廉·苏厄德主动示好，与他和解？

revisions.source: What is your position on the creation of land grant universities for secondary education?
revisions.zh: 你对设立用于中等教育的赠地大学持什么立场？

revisions.source: Do you have any comments on the Lemmon v. New York case which may be making its way to the Supreme Court?
revisions.zh: 莱蒙诉纽约州案可能上诉至最高法院。你对此有什么评论？

revisions.source: Is there a particular state that you believe the party should concentrate its resources into during the final days of the campaign?
revisions.zh: 在竞选的最后几天，你认为党应当把资源集中到哪个州？

revisions.source: Our party must stand for the abolition of slavery in this country.
revisions.zh: 我们党必须主张废除本国的奴隶制。

revisions.source: We must not allow the expansion of slavery into any new states or territories. We also must end outrages like the Fugitive Slave Law.
revisions.zh: 我们不得允许奴隶制扩展到任何新州或领地，也必须终结《逃奴法》这类暴行。

revisions.source: We must remain steadfast against the acquisition of new territories, and must combat the expansion of slavery to the extent permitted by the Supreme Court's Dred Scott decision.
revisions.zh: 我们必须坚决反对获取新领土，并在最高法院德雷德·斯科特案判决允许的范围内，抵制奴隶制扩张。

revisions.source: I'm proud to share a ballot with Hannibal Hamlin of Maine.
revisions.zh: 能与缅因州的汉尼拔·哈姆林搭档参选，我感到自豪。

revisions.source: Not at all. It would violate the norms of our times, and in any case we have a lead that we should preserve.
revisions.zh: 完全不打算亲自竞选。这有违当今惯例。况且，我们已经领先，应当保持这个优势。

revisions.source: I will not leave Springfield, but I will make several public speeches and pronouncements to make my positions clear.
revisions.zh: 我不会离开斯普林菲尔德，但会发表几次公开演说和声明，明确我的立场。

revisions.source: I made my reputation by debating Stephen A. Douglas. These extraordinary times call for extraordinary action by the candidates for President.
revisions.zh: 我正是通过与斯蒂芬·A.·道格拉斯辩论而成名。非常时期，需要总统候选人采取非常行动。

revisions.source: We can always point out a few inconsistencies with our opponents, but by and large the Republican platform is a winning platform. If we stick to it we will win in November.
revisions.zh: 我们总可以指出对手的一些自相矛盾之处，但总体而言，共和党的纲领足以赢得选举。只要坚持下去，我们就会在11月获胜。

revisions.source: Douglas has a following in several of the states that we must have this fall. We should reserve our harshest criticism for the Southern Democrats and their machinations.
revisions.zh: 在几个我们今秋必须拿下的州，道格拉斯都有追随者。我们应当把最严厉的批评留给南方民主党人及其阴谋。

revisions.source: This party has no discernible platform or political positions on any issue. They are the carcass of the pro-slavery wing of the Whig Party, masquerading as saviors of the Union.
revisions.zh: 这个党在任何议题上都没有明确的纲领或政治立场。他们不过是辉格党亲奴隶制派的残骸，却装成联邦的救星。

revisions.source: Maybe a couple of general statements against them, but overall we should avoid doing anything which might alienate former Whigs from joining the Republicans.
revisions.zh: 可以作几次笼统批评，但总体上，我们应当避免疏远那些可能加入共和党的前辉格党人。

revisions.source: Support for this party is confined to the South and border states, and we shouldn't waste our time in attacking them.
revisions.zh: 这个党的支持仅限于南方和边界州，我们不该浪费时间攻击他们。

revisions.source: The Southern Democrats are an easy target for attack. We can excite our core voters while risking little, if we denounce them.
revisions.zh: 南方民主党人很容易成为攻击目标。谴责他们，能激励我们的核心选民，而风险很小。

revisions.source: We will attack Southern Democrats the same as we would Northern Democrats. They represent the same ideas about slavery -- they differ only in their boldness about it.
revisions.zh: 我们将像攻击北方民主党人一样攻击南方民主党人。他们在奴隶制问题上的观念相同，只是表现得大胆与否有所区别。

revisions.source: Realistically, the Democratic split is fantastic news for us. Let's not galvanize the Southern block even further by attacking them.
revisions.zh: 说实在的，民主党分裂对我们是天大的好消息。不要再通过攻击，让南方阵营更加团结。

revisions.source: Whatever our private feelings, we have no choice but to denounce such extralegal actions.
revisions.zh: 无论私下怎么看，我们都只能谴责这种法律之外的行动。

revisions.source: Clearly what John Brown did was illegal, but without the obstructionism and provocation of the South on slavery, it would have never come to pass.
revisions.zh: 约翰·布朗的所作所为显然违法，但如果没有南方在奴隶制问题上的阻挠与挑衅，这件事根本不会发生。

revisions.source: Every party has political clubs and supporters. I'm proud that we have ours, and they will help drive us to victory in November.
revisions.zh: 每个政党都有自己的政治社团和支持者。我为我们拥有这些人而自豪，他们将帮助我们在11月获胜。

revisions.source: Let's try to finesse this point. It is understandably concerning to the border states to see so many young men of the North marching in military formation, with a clear organization about them.
revisions.zh: 我们要巧妙处理这一点。如此多的北方青年组织严密、按军事队列游行，难免让边界州担忧。

revisions.source: I will personally visit New York to discuss the upcoming election with Seward, pending his acquiescence of course.
revisions.zh: 当然，前提是苏厄德愿意。我会亲自前往纽约，与他讨论即将到来的大选。

revisions.source: We will send overtures to Mr. Seward and invite him to come visit us in Springfield. It's important to have a united party.
revisions.zh: 我们会向苏厄德先生示好，邀请他到斯普林菲尔德拜访我们。保持党内团结很重要。

revisions.source: Our party rejected Seward because of his unpopularity in states like Illinois and Indiana. Let's wait until after the election before we extend the olive branch to him.
revisions.zh: 我们党没有提名苏厄德，是因为他在伊利诺伊和印第安纳等州不受欢迎。等大选结束，我们再向他伸出橄榄枝吧。

revisions.source: Our party supports a high tariff and I'm proud of that fact. We need to emphasize this point during our campaign.
revisions.zh: 我们党支持高关税，我为此自豪。竞选时必须强调这一点。

revisions.source: Our position on higher tariffs is in the platform for everyone to read and discuss. We don't need to belabor the point.
revisions.zh: 我们对提高关税的立场已写入纲领，供所有人阅读讨论，没有必要反复强调。

revisions.source: I would advocate that we compromise on the issue of tariff increases and strike a moderate tone. We need to do as much as possible to make this election about slavery, and slavery alone.
revisions.zh: 我主张在提高关税的问题上作出妥协，采取温和语气。我们应当尽可能让这次大选围绕奴隶制展开，而且只谈奴隶制。

revisions.source: Everybody wants a Transcontinental Railroad, and Republicans have supported this since the beginning.
revisions.zh: 人人都想要一条横贯大陆的铁路，而共和党从一开始就支持这一点。

revisions.source: Our position on the railroad is clearly stated the platform. Our primary focus needs to be on halting the spread of slavery.
revisions.zh: 我们的铁路立场已在纲领中明确写出。主要精力应当放在阻止奴隶制扩张上。

revisions.source: We might consider sacrificing on this issue if it would help appease the Deep South. I don't think we should mention it much in this campaign.
revisions.zh: 如果有助于安抚深南部，我们可以考虑在这个问题上作出让步。这次竞选不应过多提及此事。

revisions.source: The core belief of our party is that the federal territories should be settled by honest, free, hard-working men and their families. A homestead act would be right in line with this philosophy.
revisions.zh: 我们党的核心信念是：联邦领地应当由诚实、自由、勤劳的人及其家庭来定居。宅地法完全符合这一理念。

revisions.source: Even the Northern Democrats support a homestead act. Let's stick to issues where we have a distinction to hammer on.
revisions.zh: 连北方民主党人都支持宅地法。我们还是抓住那些与对手存在分歧的议题，反复强调吧。

revisions.source: Let's discuss immigrants as little as possible in our campaign and platform. It's a no-win situation for us.
revisions.zh: 我们应当在竞选和纲领中尽可能少谈移民。这对我们是个两头不讨好的问题。

revisions.source: Germans are a key part of our new party and our vote in the Midwest. Let's express our support for the current naturalization laws.
revisions.zh: 德裔是我们这个新政党及中西部选民基础的重要组成部分。让我们明确支持现行入籍法。

revisions.source: This is the most odious, dangerous decision to be handed down in the history of the Court. What is to prevent the Court from forcing slavery next upon the states themselves, under some dubious interpretation?
revisions.zh: 这是最高法院历史上最可憎、最危险的判决。谁能阻止法院下一步借助某种可疑解释，强迫各州接受奴隶制？

revisions.source: We obviously cannot agree with this decision, but the Supreme Court lays down the law of the land, and we have little choice but to acquiesce.
revisions.zh: 我们显然无法赞同这一判决，但最高法院规定全国必须遵循的法律，我们几乎别无选择，只能接受。

revisions.source: The idea that we support social equality for blacks in society is a canard put down the Democrats, in a clumsy and transparent attempt to score political points.
revisions.zh: 所谓我们支持黑人在社会中享有平等地位，是民主党人炮制的谣言，目的只是拙劣而明显地捞取政治好处。

revisions.source: I don't believe that blacks and whites will ever mix socially in this nation, but that cannot change the fact that blacks are citizens of this nation, and should be given the voting and property rights to match that status.
revisions.zh: 我不认为黑人与白人会在本国社会中真正融合，但这不能改变黑人是本国公民的事实。他们应当享有与这一身份相符的投票权和财产权。

revisions.source: The fact that this is even under consideration as a demand shows how far beyond compromise the South has drifted.
revisions.zh: 这种要求竟然还被认真考虑，本身就说明南方已经走得太远，无法再妥协。

revisions.source: I'm sure that these are just rumors and speculation. It would be irresponsible of me at this point to extend my obvious condemnation of this step.
revisions.zh: 我相信，这些只是传闻和猜测。此时就发表我显然会持有的谴责意见，是不负责任的。

revisions.source: We oppose any effort to extend the current borders of the United States. They are plainly driven by the slave states.
revisions.zh: 我们反对任何扩大美国现有疆界的努力。这些举动显然是由蓄奴州推动的。

revisions.source: I would have to see the specific situation being proposed before I could give my own opinion on the matter.
revisions.zh: 在提出个人意见之前，我必须先看看具体建议是什么。

revisions.source: I support the personal liberty laws, and would favor a repeal or scaling back of the Fugitive Slave Law.
revisions.zh: 我支持个人自由法，也赞成废除或削弱《逃奴法》。

revisions.source: Let's try to avoid this issue in our campaign statements and speeches. No good can come of it.
revisions.zh: 竞选声明和演说中，尽量避开这个议题吧。讨论它不会带来好处。

revisions.source: The newer Fugitive Slave Law was the result of reasoned compromise in Congress. I may disagree with aspects of that Compromise, but I must accept it as a whole.
revisions.zh: 新版《逃奴法》是国会经过理性妥协的产物。我可能不同意那项妥协的某些部分，但必须接受整体。

revisions.source: We support the admission of Kansas as a free state, as soon as possible.
revisions.zh: 我们支持尽快接纳堪萨斯以自由州身份加入联邦。

revisions.source: I am willing to wait until the emotions surrounding this issue can recede a bit. If that means delaying the admission of Kansas, I will reluctantly accept that.
revisions.zh: 我愿意等这个问题周围的情绪稍微平息。如果这意味着推迟接纳堪萨斯入联邦，我也会勉强接受。

revisions.source: I would not support any Amendment that irrevocably protects slavery in the South. We would have to see if a more narrow compromise was possible.
revisions.zh: 我不会支持任何不可撤销地保护南方奴隶制的宪法修正案。我们得看看，能否达成范围更小的妥协。

revisions.source: We will absolutely not address this in our campaign. If it comes to this next year, then we can make a more specific determination at that point.
revisions.zh: 我们绝不会在竞选中谈论这个问题。如果明年真走到那一步，到时再作更具体的判断。

revisions.source: I'm open to some kind of compromise that would provide guarantees on slavery in the South, as long as it would not allow the extension of slavery to new states or territories.
revisions.zh: 我愿意考虑某种为南方奴隶制提供保障的妥协，前提是不得让奴隶制扩展到新州或领地。

revisions.source: The Union is the most important object, and we will do anything we must to preserve it.
revisions.zh: 联邦是最重要的目标。为维护它，我们会采取一切必要措施。

revisions.source: I doubt that things will come to that point, and we must not address this issue during our current campaign.
revisions.zh: 我怀疑事情会发展到那一步。我们在当前竞选中绝不能讨论这个问题。

revisions.source: Yes, let's emphasize our support of this measure. We stand behind education and the expansion of opportunity.
revisions.zh: 是的，让我们强调对这项措施的支持。我们支持教育，支持扩大机会。

revisions.source: Let's keep our mouth shut on this issue, and stick to our opposition to slavery.
revisions.zh: 这个问题上就别开口了，还是坚持反对奴隶制吧。

revisions.source: If the Court rules that slaves can be brought into free states without consequence, then we will effectively have a slave nation on our hands. This is the type of Southern aggression that we must be ever-vigilant against.
revisions.zh: 如果法院判定，奴隶可以被带入自由州而不失去奴隶身份，那么我们实际上就成了一个全国蓄奴的国家。这正是我们必须时刻警惕的南方进逼。

revisions.source: We don't know for sure if the Court will consider this case, and for now we ought to avoid making any statements on it.
revisions.zh: 我们还不能确定法院是否会审理此案，目前应当避免就此发表声明。

revisions.source: Let's keep our efforts broadly focused on the North.
revisions.zh: 让我们把精力放在整个北方。

revisions.source: I see. We shall do our best in any case.
revisions.zh: 明白。无论如何，我们都会尽力。

revisions.source: This is a fine answer for New England and the far North, but it will definitely cost you votes elsewhere.
revisions.zh: 这个回答在新英格兰和北方腹地很合适，但肯定会让你在其他地方失去选票。

revisions.source: This is right in line with the preferred Republican platform.
revisions.zh: 这完全符合共和党属意的纲领。

revisions.source: Betrayal! Many outraged Republicans are having second thoughts about your selection. Things would be much worse, but for the field you are up against.
revisions.zh: 背叛！许多愤怒的共和党人，开始重新考虑选择你是否正确。幸好对手是那些人，否则局面会糟得多。

revisions.source: Hamlin is a solid choice and a good party man.
revisions.zh: 哈姆林是个稳妥的人选，也是可靠的本党成员。

revisions.source: There's no harm in keeping a low profile during this campaign.
revisions.zh: 在这次竞选中保持低调，没有什么坏处。

revisions.source: Your active campaigning has definitely raised some eyebrows, but Douglas has decided to do the same thing. Times have certainly changed.
revisions.zh: 你积极开展竞选，确实让不少人感到惊讶，不过道格拉斯也决定这么做。时代的确变了。

revisions.source: The Democrat-Republican rivalry is alive and well, regardless of your encouragement or lack thereof.
revisions.zh: 无论你是否鼓励，民主党与共和党之间的竞争依然激烈。

revisions.source: Given these times, people are surprised to hear you lash out at the Constitutional Union Party, when both Democratic parties seem to be even worse.
revisions.zh: 在这样的时局下，民主党的两个派别看起来都更糟，你却猛烈攻击宪法联邦党，人们对此很惊讶。

revisions.source: It's a small thing, but it does help with the abolitionist bloc to remind them of the alternatives out there...
revisions.zh: 这只是小事，不过，提醒废奴派还有哪些其他选择，确实有助于争取他们……

revisions.source: There's nothing wrong with playing it safe.
revisions.zh: 谨慎行事，没有什么不妥。

revisions.source: Avoid controversy. That's the way to go.
revisions.zh: 避开争议，这才是正确做法。

revisions.source: This is a surprisingly radical viewpoint, and many moderates are expressing concern about it.
revisions.zh: 这个观点出人意料地激进，许多温和派对此表示担忧。

revisions.source: Your actions are appreciated by Seward and his New York allies, but they also look a little obsequious, coming from someone who is supposed to be the number one man. Seward is also unpopular in the lower Midwest.
revisions.zh: 苏厄德和他在纽约的盟友很感谢你的举动，不过，你本来应该是领头人，这样做却也显得有些过于奉承。苏厄德在中西部南缘也不受欢迎。

revisions.source: It is good to have a united party, heading into the fall. Make sure to keep Seward happy if you win.
revisions.zh: 临近秋季大选，保持党内团结是件好事。如果获胜，别忘了让苏厄德满意。

revisions.source: Seward is a highly popular figure in New York and Northeast. There are some murmurs of disappointment at your treatment of him.
revisions.zh: 苏厄德在纽约和东北部极受欢迎。有人私下对你待他的方式感到失望。

revisions.source: Tariffs are a winning issue in the North. There's no reason to hold back here.
revisions.zh: 关税是能在北方赢得选票的议题，没有理由在这里有所保留。

revisions.source: The railroad is a winning issue in the North. There's no reason to hold back here.
revisions.zh: 铁路是能在北方赢得选票的议题，没有理由在这里有所保留。

revisions.source: You have a lot more support to lose from immigrants themselves, than from what's left of the anti-immigrant vote. Other issues predominate this year.
revisions.zh: 比起反移民选民的残余力量，你可能失去的移民支持要多得多。今年还有更重要的议题。

revisions.source: People sense that you're trying to hedge on a difficult issue.
revisions.zh: 人们觉得，你在一个棘手问题上试图两面讨好。

revisions.source: Your weakness on the Dred Scott case is a bombshell, and the source of much consternation among Republicans.
revisions.zh: 你在德雷德·斯科特案上的软弱表态，宛如一枚重磅炸弹，令共和党人十分惊恐。

revisions.source: Your statements seem to confirm the worst fears of Northern moderates, which will certainly be further fanned by Democratic operatives.
revisions.zh: 你的声明似乎印证了北方温和派最深的担忧，民主党的竞选人员肯定还会进一步煽动这些情绪。

revisions.source: This is a bit of a weak response, but the demand has thus far been limited to radical Southerners, and seems unlikely to make headway.
revisions.zh: 这个回应有些软弱，不过，目前这个要求还局限于南方激进派，似乎不太可能取得进展。

revisions.source: This is a hedging of the Republican platform which does not play well with the party. Territorial expansion is not supported at the moment.
revisions.zh: 这等于在共和党纲领上含糊退让，党内对此并不满意。目前大家不支持领土扩张。

revisions.source: This is an issue that unites your party, and the states you need to win. There's no reason to downplay it.
revisions.zh: 这个议题能团结你们党和那些你必须拿下的州，没有理由淡化它。

revisions.source: Your weakness on this issue has given many in the party second thoughts about your nomination. Your only salvation may be the odious nature of your opponents.
revisions.zh: 你在这个问题上的软弱，让党内许多人重新考虑提名你是否正确。你或许只能指望对手足够可憎，来挽救局面。

revisions.source: It would probably be better to remain non-committal on this issue, for now.
revisions.zh: 眼下，在这个问题上大概还是不作明确承诺更好。

revisions.source: You've been asked about this question ad nauseam, but what is there to really say about it?
revisions.zh: 你已经被问得不胜其烦了，可这个问题究竟还有什么可说的？

revisions.source: This answer is a bit soft for the abolitionist wing. There is great fear that Dred Scott will be only the beginning of the Court's interference in the slavery debate.
revisions.zh: 这个回答对废奴派而言有些软弱。人们深怕，德雷德·斯科特案只是法院介入奴隶制争论的开端。

revisions.source: Good luck with the election, Mr. Lincoln, and may God be with you.
revisions.zh: 祝你竞选顺利，林肯先生，愿上帝与你同在。

revisions.source: Hopefully you are far enough ahead in New York and Pennsylvania that this fusion ticket doesn't matter.
revisions.zh: 希望你在纽约和宾夕法尼亚的领先优势足够大，不会受到这个联合选举人名单的影响。

revisions.source: What do you have to say about the merits of your running mate, Cassius Clay?
revisions.zh: 对于竞选搭档卡修斯·克莱的优点，你有什么要说的？

revisions.source: Cassius Clay has recently spoken of the need to “throw off the yoke of slavery”, which has reinforced his abolitionist reputation and alarmed many moderates. What is your stance on this?
revisions.zh: 卡修斯·克莱最近主张“摆脱奴隶制的枷锁”，进一步强化了他的废奴主义名声，也让许多温和派感到不安。你对此持什么立场？

revisions.source: I'm proud to share a ballot with Cassius Clay of Kentucky.
revisions.zh: 能与肯塔基州的卡修斯·克莱搭档参选，我感到自豪。

revisions.source: We can't afford too much infighting, but some kind of rebuke is essential. I will give a speech and make it a point to mention that I am not considering any type of hasty action on the slavery issue.
revisions.zh: 我们不能承受太多内讧，但某种批评不可避免。我会发表演说，明确提到自己并不打算在奴隶制问题上采取任何仓促行动。

revisions.source: We can't have the appearance of disunity on our ticket. We selected Mr. Clay at our convention, and we must live with the consequences.
revisions.zh: 我们的竞选组合不能显得不团结。党代会选出了克莱先生，我们就必须接受这一选择的后果。

revisions.source: Perhaps the abolitionist wing of the party got a little ahead of themselves when they foisted Cassius Clay onto the ticket.
revisions.zh: 党内废奴派把卡修斯·克莱硬塞进竞选组合时，或许有些操之过急了。

revisions.source: People, by and large, will judge the Party on its own merits. But Clay's comments have not been helpful.
revisions.zh: 总体上，人们还是会根据党的表现来判断，不过克莱的言论并没有帮上忙。

revisions.source: What do you have to say about the merits of your running mate, Salmon Chase?
revisions.zh: 对于竞选搭档萨蒙·蔡斯的优点，你有什么要说的？

revisions.source: Do you have a rebuttal for allegations that anti-slavery measures will result in a flood of free blacks into the Northern states and the territories?
revisions.zh: 有人声称，反奴隶制措施会导致大量自由黑人涌入北方各州和领地。你准备反驳吗？

revisions.source: Should your party make any statements indicating the potential support of a national bank in this election?
revisions.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党是否应当发表声明，表示可能支持设立国家银行？

revisions.source: I'm proud to share a ballot with Salmon Chase of Ohio.
revisions.zh: 能与俄亥俄州的萨蒙·蔡斯搭档参选，我感到自豪。

revisions.source: Ahh yes, this isn't the number one issue on our hands, but the old Whigs always like to hear a good speech about the national bank.
revisions.zh: 啊，没错，这不是眼下的首要议题，不过，老辉格党人总喜欢听一场精彩的国家银行演说。

revisions.source: This is a dead issue, politically, and would distract from the primary message we are attempting to make in this election.
revisions.zh: 从政治上说，这个议题已经过时了，会分散我们在本次大选中要传达的核心信息。

revisions.source: This is a scare tactic in the first place, and in any case I have always supported the colonization of freed slaves back to Africa.
revisions.zh: 这首先就是恐吓手法。况且，我一直支持把获释奴隶送往非洲殖民安置。

revisions.source: We don't stand for the abolition of slavery in the South, so the entire premise of this question is false. This is nothing that we need worry about.
revisions.zh: 我们并不主张废除南方的奴隶制，所以这个问题的整个前提就是错的。我们不必为此担忧。

revisions.source: The bank issue is dead and has been for 15 years.
revisions.zh: 银行问题早已过时，已经如此十五年了。

revisions.source: Chase is a solid choice and a good party man.
revisions.zh: 蔡斯是个稳妥的人选，也是可靠的本党成员。

revisions.source: What do you have to say about the merits of your running mate, Herschel Johnson?
revisions.zh: 对于竞选搭档赫歇尔·约翰逊的优点，你有什么要说的？

revisions.source: What is your opinion on the formation of fusion tickets in the Northern states to consolidate the anti-Lincoln vote?
revisions.zh: 你如何看待北方各州组成联合选举人名单，以整合反林肯选票的做法？

revisions.source: How aggressively should your party attack the Republicans and Abraham Lincoln in this election?
revisions.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当以多大力度攻击共和党和亚伯拉罕·林肯？

revisions.source: Will you keep your name on the ballot in Oregon and California, even if doing so might divide the anti-Lincoln vote?
revisions.zh: 即使可能分散反林肯的选票，你仍会在俄勒冈和加利福尼亚的选票上保留自己的名字吗？

revisions.source: Should your party continue its familiar attacks on the “black Republicans” as abolitionists and supporters of social and political equality for blacks?
revisions.zh: 你们党是否应当继续沿用惯常攻击，称“黑色共和党人”为废奴主义者，并指责他们支持黑人享有社会与政治平等？

revisions.source: Do you believe that a Republican victory would result in a flood of free blacks into Northern states and western territories?
revisions.zh: 你是否认为，共和党获胜将导致大量自由黑人涌入北方各州和西部领地？

revisions.source: What position should your party take on the tariff question in this election?
revisions.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当对关税问题采取什么立场？

revisions.source: How much should your party emphasize its support of canals and infrastructure projects in this election?
revisions.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当多大程度上强调对运河和基础设施建设的支持？

revisions.source: Is there a particular state that you would concentrate your efforts on during the final days of the campaign?
revisions.zh: 在竞选的最后几天，你会把精力集中到哪个州？

revisions.source: It's a bold move, but I will campaign for the Democratic cause across the North.
revisions.zh: 这是个大胆的举动，不过，我将走遍北方，为民主党的事业竞选。

revisions.source: I have always supported the Democratic ideal, that the citizens of any given state or territory should be allowed to decide the slavery question according to their own dictates.
revisions.zh: 我一向支持民主党的理想：任何州或领地的公民，都应当能够按照自己的意愿决定奴隶制问题。

revisions.source: We must make no further statements on slavery during this campaign, except that we believe the preservation of the Union to be paramount, and would consider any type of compromise Amendment on this issue once we're elected.
revisions.zh: 在这次竞选中，我们不得再就奴隶制发表声明，只应强调维护联邦至关重要；当选后，我们会考虑任何有关此事的妥协性宪法修正案。

revisions.source: The threat of a Southern schism has forced our hand. We must accept the protection of slavery in federal territories, and protect the instution in future states like Kansas and New Mexico.
revisions.zh: 南方分裂的威胁，迫使我们作出选择。我们必须接受在联邦领地保护奴隶制，并在堪萨斯、新墨西哥等未来的新州维护这一制度。

revisions.source: I'm proud to share a ballot with Herschel Vespasian Johnson of Georgia.
revisions.zh: 能与佐治亚州的赫歇尔·维斯帕先·约翰逊搭档参选，我感到自豪。

revisions.source: I will break precedent by actively campaigning, and I will focus my stops in the state of New York.
revisions.zh: 我将打破先例，积极开展竞选，并把行程重点放在纽约州。

revisions.source: I will break precedent by actively campaigning, and I will focus my stops in the state of Illinois.
revisions.zh: 我将打破先例，积极开展竞选，并把行程重点放在伊利诺伊州。

revisions.source: Like most candidates, I will remain above the fray personally, and allow my supporters to stump on my behalf.
revisions.zh: 像多数候选人一样，我个人将置身竞选纷争之外，让支持者代我巡回演说。

revisions.source: Lincoln and his party are abolitionists, whether they care to admit it or not. I don't believe a majority in the North would support them if this were fully understood.
revisions.zh: 无论他们是否愿意承认，林肯及其政党都是废奴主义者。如果北方人充分了解这一点，我不相信多数人还会支持他们。

revisions.source: We'll attack the Republicans the same as any other opponents.
revisions.zh: 我们将像攻击其他对手一样攻击共和党。

revisions.source: We may have our issues with Lincoln, but our primary attacks should be reserved for the duplicitous Southern party, and the ambiguous Constitutional Union organization.
revisions.zh: 我们或许与林肯有分歧，但主要火力应当留给两面三刀的南方党派，以及立场含糊的宪法联邦党。

revisions.source: We'll attack the Constitutional Union party the same as any other opponents.
revisions.zh: 我们将像攻击其他对手一样攻击宪法联邦党。

revisions.source: Anyone who supports the Union is fine in my book, at least in comparison to the secessionist Southern Democrats.
revisions.zh: 在我看来，凡是支持联邦的人都不错，至少比主张分离的南方民主党人好。

revisions.source: We need to make it perfectly clear that we have no use for this secessionist splinter group, and that we are a national party that truly represents Democracy in this country.
revisions.zh: 我们必须讲得清清楚楚：我们与这个主张分离的分裂派毫无瓜葛，而我们才是真正代表本国民主的全国性政党。

revisions.source: We'll attack the Southern Democrats the same as any other opponents.
revisions.zh: 我们将像攻击其他对手一样攻击南方民主党人。

revisions.source: We've obviously had our falling out at the Convention this year, but we will eventually need to rebuild our party. Going on the attack in this case will only make things worse.
revisions.zh: 今年党代会上，我们显然已经闹翻，但最终仍需要重建本党。这时候展开攻击，只会让事情更糟。

revisions.source: This is no time for false pride. Let's do what we can to build a fusion ticket where that action makes sense, and worry about the rest when we get to it.
revisions.zh: 现在不是死要面子的时候。凡是组成联合选举人名单有意义的地方，我们都应尽力促成；其他问题，到时候再说。

revisions.source: I will never appear on a fusion ticket with Breckinridge, but I will take my name off the ballot in the slave states (barring Missouri, of course). Hopefully he and Bell will reciprocate in the north.
revisions.zh: 我绝不会与布雷肯里奇出现在同一个联合选举人名单中，但会撤下自己在蓄奴州选票上的名字——当然，密苏里除外。希望他和贝尔在北方投桃报李。

revisions.source: We cannot sacrifice the prestige of the Democratic Party by making these kinds of deals.
revisions.zh: 我们不能为了达成这种交易，牺牲民主党的声望。

revisions.source: I will take my name off the ballot in those states. We just need to make sure Lincoln doesn't win them.
revisions.zh: 我会把自己的名字从这些州的选票上撤下。我们只需要确保林肯赢不了这些州。

revisions.source: No, I will not. I have a good chance of winning them and I need every vote I can get.
revisions.zh: 不，我不会退出。我很有希望赢得这些州，也需要争取每一张选票。

revisions.source: We will condemn the activity of any such self-styled revolutionaries. John Brown was a fanatic and a lunatic.
revisions.zh: 我们将谴责任何这类自封革命者的行动。约翰·布朗是个狂热分子，也是个疯子。

revisions.source: We will keep silent on this episode as we campaign.
revisions.zh: 我们在竞选中不会评论这件事。

revisions.source: In our volatile environment, it is hardly helpful to have many thousand young men marching in pseudo-military garb, professing their support for the Republicans.
revisions.zh: 在我们这个动荡的局势下，成千上万的青年穿着仿军事服装游行，宣称支持共和党，实在无助于局面。

revisions.source: Of course we should. This is one of most effective attacks we have against the shenanigans of the Republicans.
revisions.zh: 当然应该。这是我们针对共和党胡作非为所能发动的最有效攻击之一。

revisions.source: I'm sure people out there will make these attacks on their own initiative, but we shouldn't emphasize this too much.
revisions.zh: 我相信，自有人会主动发动这些攻击，但我们不应过分强调。

revisions.source: It might be in our best interest to play down such rhetoric in this particular campaign. Our base in the North will vote for us anyway, and it's not as if we have any Southern support to lose at this point.
revisions.zh: 在这次特殊的竞选中，淡化这种言辞或许更符合我们的利益。北方基本盘反正会投给我们，而眼下我们在南方也没有什么支持可失去了。

revisions.source: Everybody knows that the Democrats are the party of low tariffs, and we intend to keep it that way.
revisions.zh: 人人都知道，民主党是主张低关税的政党。我们打算保持这个立场。

revisions.source: Let's moderate our stance on the tariff issue a bit, given the peculiar nature of this election.  Even President Buchanan appears to be changing his views.
revisions.zh: 鉴于本次大选的特殊情况，我们在关税问题上的立场应当稍微温和一些。就连布坎南总统似乎也在改变看法。

revisions.source: I've been an advocate of a Transcontinental Railroad for the past decade. We need to make sure that is appreciated by the voters.
revisions.zh: 过去十年，我一直主张修建横贯大陆铁路。我们必须确保选民知道这一点。

revisions.source: Of course we'll support this railroad, but there are other issues we should emphasize in this campaign.
revisions.zh: 我们当然会支持这条铁路，不过，这次竞选中还有其他议题应当强调。

revisions.source: Perhaps as a compromise with the sentiment of the Deep South, we could accept a new position on this issue.
revisions.zh: 或许，为了向深南部的情绪作出妥协，我们可以在这个问题上接受一个新立场。

revisions.source: This has been a Democratic idea since the days of Andrew Jackson. We support it completely.
revisions.zh: 自安德鲁·杰克逊时代以来，这一直是民主党的主张。我们完全支持。

revisions.source: Anyone can see that we support this idea, but our main emphasis should be on other issues.
revisions.zh: 谁都看得出，我们支持这个主张，不过，主要精力应当放在其他议题上。

revisions.source: Part of any compromise with Southern Democrats would involve a resolution in the territories. By what rights should planters be denied their opportunity to purchase western land?
revisions.zh: 与南方民主党人达成任何妥协，都应当包括解决领地问题。凭什么剥夺种植园主购买西部土地的机会？

revisions.source: The Democrats are in favor of our current naturalization laws. That is my position and I stand by it.
revisions.zh: 民主党支持现行入籍法。这就是我的立场，我会坚持。

revisions.source: Let's skirt this issue and attempt to focus our campaign on other things. There's not much for us to gain here.
revisions.zh: 让我们避开这个问题，尽量把竞选重点放在其他事情上。我们在这里没有多少好处可得。

revisions.source: We believe that the Supreme Court is the highest law in the land, and should be respected by all decent Americans.
revisions.zh: 我们认为，最高法院是全国最高的法律权威，每一个正派的美国人都应当尊重它。

revisions.source: There's nothing in this decision which contradicts my own ideas on slavery. Slavery can hardly thrive in a territory where the residents oppose the practice, regardless of the Court's abstractions on the issue.
revisions.zh: 这项判决与我对奴隶制的观点并不矛盾。无论法院对此作出怎样抽象的论断，奴隶制都很难在居民反对它的领地兴盛起来。

revisions.source: Our goal in this campaign should be to avoid any mention of the Supreme Court. There's not much to gain by talking about this decision.
revisions.zh: 这次竞选的目标，应当是避免提及最高法院。讨论这项判决，没有多少好处。

revisions.source: We join the Republicans in denouncing this decision. We may have our differences, but we can all agree that this Court has acted well beyond its bounds in this case.
revisions.zh: 我们将与共和党一起谴责这项判决。彼此虽然有分歧，但都能同意：在此案中，法院的作为远远越过了界限。

revisions.source: This is the type of aggressive, expansive move by the Southern Democrats that led to the split in our party. Under no circumstances would I support the reopening of the Atlantic slave trade.
revisions.zh: 南方民主党人这种咄咄逼人、扩张性的举动，正是导致我们党分裂的原因。无论如何，我都不会支持重启跨大西洋奴隶贸易。

revisions.source: Let's keep a low profile on this issue and hope it passes. We don't need to make things worse by issuing controversial statements.
revisions.zh: 这个问题上，我们应当保持低调，盼它自行过去。没有必要发表有争议的声明，让局面更糟。

revisions.source: My party and I support the acquisition of Cuba, and of other territories if possible.
revisions.zh: 我和本党都支持取得古巴，并在可能的情况下取得其他领土。

revisions.source: This is an abstract question at this point. We can barely hold this country together as it is, without addressing some theoretical expansion into the Caribbean.
revisions.zh: 眼下，这是个空泛的问题。维持国家统一已经十分困难，根本顾不上讨论向加勒比扩张这种假设。

revisions.source: I don't support the further expansion of the United States. We should be focused on the development of the territories that we have, and not on gaining new ones.
revisions.zh: 我不支持美国进一步扩张。我们应当专注于开发已经拥有的领地，而不是获取新的领土。

revisions.source: These are the types of radical abolitionist measures which have caused so many problems in our politics. The federal law takes precedence.
revisions.zh: 这些激进的废奴主义措施，已经给我们的政治生活带来了太多问题。联邦法律具有优先效力。

revisions.source: I'm not going to make any statements condemning these laws during the present campaign. That would be a hasty, alienating move on our part.
revisions.zh: 在当前竞选中，我不会发表声明谴责这些法律。那样做仓促而且会疏远选民。

revisions.source: Absolutely I would. Not only would this prevent a potential war and preserve the Union, but it would remove slavery from the realm of political debate once and for all.
revisions.zh: 我当然会支持。这不仅能避免潜在战争、维护联邦，还能让奴隶制彻底退出政治争论。

revisions.source: I would need to see the details of these Amendments before I could take a position.
revisions.zh: 在表态之前，我需要看看这些宪法修正案的细节。

revisions.source: Not really. I'm all for compromise between the sections, but how could we have a permanent Amendment to the Constitution? Couldn't we have another Amendment to amend that Amendment?
revisions.zh: 不太支持。我完全赞成各地区之间的妥协，但我们怎么能有一项永久不变的宪法修正案？难道不能再通过另一项修正案，去修改这一项吗？

revisions.source: Let there be no question that I support the preservation of the Union above all else.
revisions.zh: 毫无疑问，我把维护联邦置于一切之上。

revisions.source: If I am elected, this type of thing would not happen. This question has no relevance to events.
revisions.zh: 如果我当选，这种事情就不会发生。这个问题与实际局势无关。

revisions.source: This is the logical conclusion of the Republican program, if they succeed in closing off slavery and slowly extinguishing it.
revisions.zh: 如果共和党成功遏制奴隶制，并使之逐渐消亡，这就是他们纲领合乎逻辑的结果。

revisions.source: We should hold back on this kind of rhetoric, given the unusual nature of this year's election.
revisions.zh: 鉴于今年大选的特殊情况，我们应当克制这种言辞。

revisions.source: Not at all. This argument has come up in the past, but we should take a more careful analysis of it this time around.
revisions.zh: 完全不认为如此。这种论点以前也出现过，但这次我们应该更谨慎地分析。

revisions.source: This action is perfectly in line with my own doctrine. The will of the voters in Kansas clearly calls for admission as a free state.
revisions.zh: 这个行动完全符合我的学说。堪萨斯选民的意愿，显然是以自由州身份加入联邦。

revisions.source: We've had too many competing votes and constitutions to make any determination about Kansas. We should not admit that state at this time, until there is more clarity.
revisions.zh: 关于堪萨斯，彼此竞争的投票和宪法方案太多，难以下定论。目前不应接纳它入联邦，必须等局势更明朗。

revisions.source: Part of any future compromise with Southern interests may involve the admission of Kansas as a slave state. We should not preclude that possibility at the current time.
revisions.zh: 未来与南方利益集团达成的妥协，可能包括接纳堪萨斯以蓄奴州身份加入联邦。眼下我们不应排除这种可能。

revisions.source: We need to show that we understand the problems of our day, which includes support for canals, harbors, and railroads.
revisions.zh: 我们必须表明，自己理解当今的问题，其中就包括支持运河、港口和铁路。

revisions.source: Let's avoid making any strong statements on this issue, and keep our focus to the debate on slavery and other things.
revisions.zh: 让我们避免在这个问题上发表强硬声明，继续把重点放在奴隶制等议题的争论上。

revisions.source: We are the Jacksonian Party, and there is no place in our platform for federal spending on such boondoggles.
revisions.zh: 我们是杰克逊主义政党，纲领中不容联邦政府在这种劳民伤财的工程上花钱。

revisions.source: I will concentrate on Illinois, Indiana, and Ohio.
revisions.zh: 我将把精力集中在伊利诺伊、印第安纳和俄亥俄。

revisions.source: I will make one final stop in New York to campaign.
revisions.zh: 我将在纽约作最后一次竞选停留。

revisions.source: I will remain in Illinois for the final week of this campaign.
revisions.zh: 在竞选最后一周，我将留在伊利诺伊。

revisions.source: Our case is hopeless in this election. I will go south and speak out against secession, to the best of my capacity.
revisions.zh: 这次大选，我们已经毫无希望。我将尽力前往南方，发表反对脱离联邦的演说。

revisions.source: I will support any fusion tickets which can be organized, and I will withdraw my name from the slave state ballots. We must find a way to stop Lincoln.
revisions.zh: 我将支持任何能够组成的联合选举人名单，并且把自己的名字从蓄奴州的选票上撤下。我们必须找到办法阻止林肯。

revisions.source: Since the Southern vote is lost already, this just might help you a shade in those states where you can still compete.
revisions.zh: 既然南方选票已经丢了，这么做或许能让你在那些仍有竞争力的州稍微获益。

revisions.source: This is right in line with the Democratic platform, and with your own position over the years.
revisions.zh: 这完全符合民主党的纲领，也符合你多年来的立场。

revisions.source: This is a bit of a change from your earlier position, but it won't do you much harm.
revisions.zh: 这与先前的立场有些不同，但不会给你造成太大损害。

revisions.source: This attempt to reconcile with the Southern Democrats has fallen on deaf ears. Unfortunately, it seems to have cost you elsewhere.
revisions.zh: 试图与南方民主党人和解的努力，没有得到回应。遗憾的是，似乎还让你在其他地方付出了代价。

revisions.source: There are some guffaws, but you are enough of a mountebank in the first place that you might come out ahead on this deal.
revisions.zh: 有人大笑嘲讽，不过，你本来就够像个江湖骗子了，这笔交易也许反而能让你占点便宜。

revisions.source: People are noticing the amount of time you are putting into New York. Do you have a plan which depends upon that state?
revisions.zh: 人们注意到，你在纽约花了很多时间。你的计划是不是仰赖这个州？

revisions.source: People are noticing the amount of time you are putting into Illinois. Do you have a plan which depends upon that state?
revisions.zh: 人们注意到，你在伊利诺伊花了很多时间。你的计划是不是仰赖这个州？

revisions.source: A tiny sliver of Northern moderates appreciate this rare display of magnanimity.
revisions.zh: 极少数北方温和派，欣赏你这次难得表现出的宽宏大量。

revisions.source: The Constitutional Unionists are not your biggest issue in this campaign.
revisions.zh: 宪法联邦党人不是你这次竞选中最需要担心的对手。

revisions.source: An appeal to sectional pride may be your only trick left.
revisions.zh: 诉诸地域自豪感，或许是你最后剩下的一招。

revisions.source: This is a clumsy gesture towards a party which has irreconcilably split away.
revisions.zh: 对一个已经彻底分裂出去、无法调和的政党，这番示好显得笨拙。

revisions.source: Fusion tickets have been organized in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania. Your name will head the ballot in New York and New Jersey.
revisions.zh: 纽约、新泽西和宾夕法尼亚已组成联合选举人名单。纽约和新泽西的选票将以你的名字领衔。

revisions.source: This move seems to help Bell in the South. He has removed himself from the Midwestern ballots. Breckinridge ignores your overtures.
revisions.zh: 这项举动似乎帮助了贝尔在南方的竞选。他已退出中西部各州的选票，而布雷肯里奇没有理会你的示好。

revisions.source: This is a principled viewpoint, that also removes what little chance you might have of carrying New York and New Jersey.
revisions.zh: 这个立场有原则，却也让你失去了赢得纽约和新泽西的那一点微弱希望。

revisions.source: Depending on your goals, this could be a reasonable course of action.
revisions.zh: 这或许是个合理做法，取决于你的目标。

revisions.source: It's an easy victory for you to criticize John Brown.
revisions.zh: 批评约翰·布朗，对你来说很容易得分。

revisions.source: This answer is right in line with the traditional platform.
revisions.zh: 这个回答完全符合传统纲领。

revisions.source: Tariffs are highly popular in the North. Since the Southern wing has defected anyway, it might change your political calculations.
revisions.zh: 关税在北方极受欢迎。既然南方派已经离党，这或许应该改变你的政治盘算。

revisions.source: Homesteads are a winning issue in the North. There's no reason to hold back here.
revisions.zh: 宅地是能在北方赢得选票的议题，没有理由在这里有所保留。

revisions.source: The Irish vote will be a huge part of your support in this election. You need to keep them energized.
revisions.zh: 在这次大选中，爱尔兰选民将成为你支持基础中的重要部分。你必须保持他们的热情。

revisions.source: Negativity on the Dred Scott decision is confined to the Republican vote.
revisions.zh: 对德雷德·斯科特案判决的负面看法，仅限于共和党选民。

revisions.source: Opposition to the reopening of the slave trade is a no-brainer.
revisions.zh: 反对重启奴隶贸易，是不假思索就能作出的选择。

revisions.source: With the walkout of the South, it might be best to moderate the Democratic party line on this issue.
revisions.zh: 既然南方派已经退出，这个问题上，最好让民主党的传统立场温和一些。

revisions.source: It would be better to reserve judgment on this issue until after the election. Many moderates would support some kind of compromise if the alternative was secession and civil war.
revisions.zh: 在大选结束前，最好暂不对这个问题作出判断。如果另一种选择是分离和内战，许多温和派都会支持某种妥协。

revisions.source: Your support for the Union rightly takes precedence over the political issues of the day.
revisions.zh: 你对联邦的支持，理应优先于当今的政治议题。

revisions.source: Your support for the Union should rightly take precedence over the political issues of the day. People wonder why you aren't more forceful on this point.
revisions.zh: 你对联邦的支持，理应优先于当今的政治议题。人们不明白，为什么你在这一点上没有更有力地表态。

revisions.source: This is a concern of many Democratic voters. There's a little mumbling about your sudden reticence.
revisions.zh: 许多民主党选民都担心这一点。你突然缄默起来，也引发了一些私下议论。

revisions.source: This is anathema to most Northerners, including many moderates and Democrats.
revisions.zh: 大多数北方人，包括许多温和派和民主党人，都极为反对这个主张。

revisions.source: Times have changed since the 1830s, and many are coming around to the idea of some spending on infrastructure.
revisions.zh: 时代已不同于1830年代，许多人开始认同，应该在基础设施上花一些钱。

revisions.source: Good luck with the election, Mr. Douglas, and may God be with you.
revisions.zh: 祝你竞选顺利，道格拉斯先生，愿上帝与你同在。

revisions.source: This certainly shakes up the race. Fusion tickets have been organized in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania.
revisions.zh: 这无疑打乱了选情。纽约、新泽西和宾夕法尼亚已组成联合选举人名单。

revisions.source: What do you have to say about the merits of your running mate, James Guthrie?
revisions.zh: 对于竞选搭档詹姆斯·格思里的优点，你有什么要说的？

revisions.source: I'm proud to share a ballot with James Guthrie of Kentucky.
revisions.zh: 能与肯塔基州的詹姆斯·格思里搭档参选，我感到自豪。

revisions.source: We support this idea as a positive step for working men in this country.
revisions.zh: 我们支持这个主张，认为它对本国劳动者是积极的一步。

revisions.source: This is not something that we should address in our campaign. We should channel our focus on other issues.
revisions.zh: 这不是我们应当在竞选中讨论的事情。我们应该把精力集中到其他议题上。

revisions.source: This strikes me, and many Democrats, as a potential waste of federal land and resources.
revisions.zh: 在我和许多民主党人看来，这可能是在浪费联邦土地和资源。

revisions.source: This is definitely more of a Republican issue at this point.
revisions.zh: 眼下，这显然更像是共和党的议题。

revisions.source: What do you have to say about the merits of your running mate, Horatio Seymour?
revisions.zh: 对于竞选搭档霍雷肖·西摩的优点，你有什么要说的？

revisions.source: Did you make any deals to reward New York in your administration, to get Horatio Seymour to agree to serve as your running mate?
revisions.zh: 为了让霍雷肖·西摩同意担任竞选搭档，你是否达成过在未来政府中优待纽约州的交易？

revisions.source: I'm proud to share a ballot with Horatio Seymour of New York.
revisions.zh: 能与纽约州的霍雷肖·西摩搭档参选，我感到自豪。

revisions.source: That's ridiculous. Of course not!
revisions.zh: 荒唐！当然没有！

revisions.source: An all-northern ticket has raised a few eyebrows, but maybe it's the best choice given the nature of this election.
revisions.zh: 全北方的竞选组合让一些人惊讶，不过，鉴于这场大选的性质，也许这才是最好的选择。

revisions.source: Way to protest your innocence. But New York, and the rest of the Union, get the message anyhow.
revisions.zh: 你倒是很卖力地声明自己清白。不过，纽约和联邦其他地方的人，还是领会到了那个意思。
